name: ChangeThisFile
description: Convert files between 690+ formats — image, video, audio, documents, ebooks, and archives. Free, no auth required.

tools.name: convert_file
tools.title: Convert File
tools.description: Convert a file from one format to another. Add a verified ChangeThisFile API key for the shared developer allowance (25 free conversions/month); anonymous access is temporary compatibility mode. Pass EITHER a publicly accessible URL (source_url) OR base64-encoded file contents (base64_content + source_format) — exactly one is required. Returns a temporary download URL (valid 1 hour; file deleted within 24 hours).

source_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the file to convert (preferred for large files)

base64_content.description: Base64-encoded file content (for small files; max ~5MB)

source_format.description: Source format extension (e.g. "docx", "mp4"). Optional: detected from filename, URL response filename, or file bytes when omitted.

filename.description: Optional filename hint for auto-detection (e.g. "document.docx"). Include this for extensionless download URLs when known.

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.title: List Supported Conversions
tools.description: List all supported conversion routes. Optionally filter by source format to see what you can convert FROM a specific format.

source_format.description: Filter by source format (e.g. "docx" returns all DOCX target options)

tools.name: translate_file
tools.title: Translate Document (paid, free preview)
tools.description: Translate a document into another language with the original layout and formatting preserved (DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, PDF, TXT, MD, SRT, VTT). The job runs immediately and returns a FREE preview of the first pages plus a secure Stripe checkout link — the full translated file unlocks after payment ($4.99, one-time, no account needed). Provide EITHER source_url OR base64_content, plus a filename with extension.

source_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the input file (preferred for large files)

filename.description: Filename WITH extension (e.g. "report.pdf"). Required when the format cannot be inferred from source_url.

tools.name: extract_tables
tools.title: Extract Tables to Excel (paid, free preview)
tools.description: Extract every table from a PDF or image (PNG, JPG, WebP) into a clean multi-sheet Excel file. The job runs immediately and returns a FREE preview of the first table plus a secure Stripe checkout link — the full .xlsx unlocks after payment ($3.99, one-time, no account needed). Provide EITHER source_url OR base64_content, plus a filename with extension.

source_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the input file (preferred for large files)

filename.description: Filename WITH extension (e.g. "report.pdf"). Required when the format cannot be inferred from source_url.

tools.name: compress_file
tools.title: Compress File to Exact Size (free)
tools.description: Compress a file (PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP, MP4, MOV, WebM) down to an exact target size — e.g. "under 5MB for an upload form". FREE (daily limit applies). Returns a download URL on success; if the target is physically unreachable it fails honestly and reports the smallest achievable size. Provide EITHER source_url OR base64_content, plus a filename with extension.

source_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the input file (preferred for large files)

filename.description: Filename WITH extension (e.g. "report.pdf"). Required when the format cannot be inferred from source_url.

target_size_kb.description: Target maximum size in kilobytes (e.g. 5120 for 5MB). Min 50KB.

tools.name: do_file_job
tools.title: Do Something to a File (natural language)
tools.description: Describe what you want done to a file in plain language — e.g. "translate this contract to German", "pull every table out of this PDF into Excel", "shrink this video to under 25MB", "convert this to PDF". The instruction is routed to the right job automatically; if the request is not supported yet you get an honest explanation of what is. Provide EITHER source_url OR base64_content, plus a filename with extension.

instruction.description: What to do with the file, in plain language (any language)

source_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the input file (preferred for large files)

filename.description: Filename WITH extension (e.g. "report.pdf"). Required when the format cannot be inferred from source_url.

tools.name: check_job
tools.title: Check Job Status
tools.description: Check the status of a previously submitted file job (translate_file, extract_tables, compress_file). Returns the current status, preview + checkout link for completed paid jobs, or the download URL for completed free/paid-and-unlocked jobs.

job_id.description: The job_id returned by a job tool
